metadata.short_desc: Knowledge-base backed long-term memory, recall, and management tools.
metadata.desc: Adds long-term memory to AstrBot using the built-in knowledge base for user preferences, past interactions, and important facts.

kb_name.hint: Select the knowledge base used to store long-term memories. Required. Create one first in Knowledge Base Management and configure an embedding model.

extraction_provider_id.hint: LLM used to extract memories from conversations. Leave empty to use the current chat model.

summarization_provider_id.hint: LLM used for future memory merging and compression. Leave empty to use the current chat model.

auto_memorize.hint: When enabled, memories are automatically extracted and stored after conversations.

extraction_interval.hint: Run memory extraction every N conversation turns and summarize those turns.

extraction_min_content_length.hint: Skip memory extraction when the accumulated conversation is shorter than this many characters.

global_memory.hint: Within the same platform instance, personal memories follow their owners across groups and DMs and allow injecting cross-session contact summaries. Disable to restrict them to their original session without contact summaries. Does not control group or global memories.

share_contacts_across_bots.hint: Share known session records for the same user ID across bots within the same platform instance. Affects only the contact index and does not change memory visibility or bypass sharing or admin checks.

share_group_across_groups.hint: Share group-scoped memories with other groups of the same platform instance, never DMs. Does not expand personal or conversation visibility.

recall_query_max_chars.hint: Bound automatic and tool recall queries to 128–2048 characters, preserving the current question first. Explicit length errors allow at most one shortened retry per recall.

recall_timeout_seconds.hint: All recall channels share a 2–30 second deadline; automatic query optimization uses at most 40%. Keep successful channels without retrying the whole operation.

max_memories_per_inject.hint: Maximum number of memories injected into each LLM request.

max_memory_list_scan.hint: Limits how many records /memory list scans to calculate memories visible to the current user. The actual scan amount is derived from the page and page size and will not exceed this limit.

memory_delete_scan_page_size.hint: Number of matched records scanned per page before deleting or clearing memories. Larger values are faster but use more memory per operation.

memory_ttl_days.hint: Low-frequency memories older than this many days may be compressed into impressions.

use_reranker.hint: Use the knowledge base reranker to improve memory recall ordering. Requires a reranker model configured on the knowledge base.

optimize_recall_query.hint: Before each memory recall, call the extraction model to extract search keywords for better recall accuracy. This runs on every conversation, so use a fast lightweight model.

optimize_recall_query_timeout.hint: Maximum wait time for recall query optimization. On timeout, the original query is used so conversation responses are not blocked.

enable_admin_global_memory_tool.hint: When enabled, provides administrator-only global-memory storage plus exact search and confirmed removal across global, personal, group, and conversation scopes.

recall_sparse_fusion.hint: Adds FTS5 keyword sparse retrieval atop dense vector search and fuses both via RRF, improving recall for keywords/proper nouns. Falls back to dense-only when FTS5 is unavailable.

recall_weight_importance.hint: Weight of importance in recall re-ranking (0-1)

recall_weight_frequency.hint: Weight of recall_count frequency in recall re-ranking (0-1)

recall_weight_recency.hint: Weight of time decay in recall re-ranking (0-1)

recall_recency_halflife_days.hint: Recency decay halflife: a memory N days old scores about 0.5

memory_consolidation_enabled.hint: Periodically compress low-frequency old memories into summary impressions via LLM; originals are marked deprecated. Requires a summarization model.

consolidation_min_age_days.hint: Only consolidate memories older than this many days

consolidation_max_recall.hint: Only consolidate low-frequency memories with recall count at or below this (avoids compressing frequently-used memories)

consolidation_batch_size.hint: Maximum number of memories processed per consolidation run

maintenance.hint: Collapsed group: background extraction, existing-memory inspection, relation analysis, review, auto purge, and review notifications. Legacy top-level maintenance_* keys migrate here automatically on first load

enabled.hint: Run scheduled memory maintenance via cron (requires AstrBot 4.30+ and a maintenance model)

model_id.hint: LLM used by background maintenance agents. A lightweight model is recommended; leave empty to use the default chat LLM

window.hint: Single time such as 03:00 or range such as 02:00-06:00; cron triggers outside this window are skipped with a DEBUG log

cron.hint: Standard 5-field cron expression; defaults to 03:00 daily to run the full maintenance pipeline (purge, extract, organizer, analyst, reviewer)

max_llm_calls.hint: Hard cap on total LLM calls across all agents within a single maintenance cycle

max_ops_per_cycle.hint: Hard cap on total operations proposed by the organizer and analyst per cycle; excess items are deferred to the next cycle

llm_timeout.hint: Maximum wait time for a single background LLM request

pending_queue_max.hint: Maximum pending items kept in the manual review queue; excess items are dropped and logged

extract_enabled.hint: Slice conversation blocks from the inbox buffer by time windows (pure rules) and extract new memories each cycle; disable to only reorganize existing memories

curator_model_id.hint: LLM used to extract memories from conversation blocks; falls back to the global maintenance model when empty

segment_time_gap_minutes.hint: Adjacent buffered turns farther apart than this are split into different conversation blocks; pure rules without LLM calls

segment_max_chars.hint: Maximum flattened text length of one conversation block before splitting into the next

extract_max_blocks_per_cycle.hint: Maximum conversation blocks extracted in one maintenance cycle; the rest is deferred to the next cycle

extract_llm_budget_ratio.hint: Share of the per-cycle LLM call cap allocated to conversation extraction (gate + extraction); the rest is reserved for existing-memory maintenance

organizer_enabled.hint: Merge duplicate memories, run single-item inspections, archive worthless entries, and rewrite them neutrally

organizer_model_id.hint: LLM used for single-item inspection and cleaning decisions; falls back to the global maintenance model when empty

organizer_batch_size.hint: Maximum memories sampled per cycle for single-item inspection

organizer_merge_batch_size.hint: Maximum memories sampled in the merge similarity pre-screen, independent of the inspection batch

analyst_enabled.hint: Classify same-scope memory pairs into merge/link/conflict/none to discover implicit links and contradictions

analyst_max_new_links.description: Max New Links per Analyst Run
analyst_max_new_links.hint: Maximum number of new memory links the analyst may propose in one maintenance cycle

analyst_detect_contradiction.hint: Enable contradiction detection for pairs of conflicting memories during analyst runs

analyst_max_contradictions.hint: Maximum number of contradictory memory pairs reported by the analyst per cycle

analyst_max_merges.hint: Maximum number of merge operations the analyst may propose in one maintenance cycle

analyst_batch_size.hint: Maximum memories sampled in the analyst's similarity pre-screen to avoid huge similarity matrices on large knowledge bases

reviewer_enabled.hint: Review proposed changes from the organizer and analyst before execution to prevent accidental deletions or edits

reviewer_model_id.hint: LLM used to review proposed operations; leave empty to use the global maintenance model

reviewer_prompt_extra.hint: Extra rules appended to the reviewer prompt; leave empty to omit

verification_max_per_cycle.hint: Maximum low-confidence operations verified by the controlled verification agent per cycle

verification_confidence_threshold.hint: Operations whose cleaning/classification confidence falls below this go to controlled verification before review

auto_purge_enabled.hint: Periodically hard-delete memories marked deprecated past the retention window

auto_purge_after_days.hint: Hard-delete memories marked deprecated for longer than this many days

auto_purge_cron.hint: Standard 5-field cron expression; defaults to 05:00 daily

review_notify_enabled.hint: Proactively notify administrators when controversial maintenance operations await approval

review_notify_umo.hint: Select or enter the group or private chat unified_msg_origin for review notifications; leave empty to disable proactive notifications

review_notify_schedule.hint: Reserved for compatibility: notifications are currently sent when new controversial operations are queued rather than on a schedule

review_notify_time.hint: Reserved for compatibility: notifications are currently sent when new controversial operations are queued rather than at a fixed time

context_max_rounds.hint: Reserved for compatibility: the pipeline now extracts incrementally from the inbox buffer instead of pulling platform history by rounds

context_max_chars.hint: Reserved for compatibility: the pipeline now extracts incrementally from the inbox buffer instead of pulling platform history by characters

context_max_age_days.hint: Reserved for compatibility: expired inbox rows are cleaned by the lifecycle instead of looking back through platform history

persona_mode.hint: auto = extract from default persona, manual = use custom summary below, off = disabled

persona_summary.hint: Used in manual mode to provide conversational context to maintenance agents

memory_review.title: Pending Memory Reviews
memory_review.description: Approve or reject controversial operations from background memory maintenance
